0.content:
Amber's grandfather once led a mercenary company in Liyue Harbor, escorting merchant caravans. When monsters wiped out one caravan, he was the sole survivor, saved by a Knights of Favonius doctor. Ashamed to go home and wanting to repay the debt, he joined the Knights. He founded the Outriders, trained every member personally, married in Mondstadt and raised a family. Moved by his granddaughter's secret practice, he taught her everything he knew: "When Mondstadt accepted me, it became my homeland." Four years before the Traveler arrived, just after Amber joined the Outriders, he left his sword and coat of arms in his office and disappeared without a note.

Without him the Outriders lost discipline, failed missions, shed veterans and survived in name only, while rumours called him a defector. He also mentored the young Eula and cooked Liyue dishes for Amber after training. Canon leaves his fate and motives unknown; theories tying him to Qingce Village or to the traitor Eroch are not confirmed.

1.content:
The Outriders were the Knights of Favonius' scouting team of archers, famed for tracking and for sensing danger. Since its founder left, the team has been a shell, kept for its structure and name, with Amber its only member. She patrols the outskirts, meets newcomers first, escorts travellers and clears monster camps. Outriders also use wind gliders, and Amber issues gliding licenses.

In 6.2 Jean decided not to rebuild a separate recon squad. Each company will instead grow its own scouts, using Amber's training of a junior as the template. Amber stays the Knights' "one and only independent Outrider".

2.content:
Eula, Captain of the Reconnaissance Company and a descendant of the disgraced Lawrence Clan, is Amber's closest friend. They were friends long before Eula joined the Knights; Eula was the beloved student of Amber's grandfather, and Amber trusts her completely. Amber cleaned Eula's dorm and gave her a tour on her first day, runs her errands, and gets shopkeepers to charge her normal prices. Eula grumbles that everyone now treats her like an older sibling who needs a younger one to do everything, and vows that Amber "must pay" for it. Amber insists Eula is only misunderstood because of her family name and her sense of humour.

Amber stands on crates in the square announcing Eula's achievements, such as rescuing a Liyue legal expert at Dornman Port and capturing the Abyss Order agents there. Attitudes toward Eula have softened noticeably, and Amber is the person most delighted by it. In 5.6 she said Eula keeps secrets like "an impenetrable wall".

3.content: "I joined the Knights because of my grandpa, I stayed because of Jean." Amber trusts the Acting Grand Master absolutely; in the Prologue she told the Traveler that everything would be fine with Jean on their side. She frets that Jean carries every burden, wants to invite her for coffee (Jean's coffee is Amber's favourite) and fears Jean catching her lazing about. Jean says Amber's recent growth impresses her and hopes her deeds will one day be sung by bards.

4.content:
In the official manga, set less than a year before the Traveler arrived, Collei came to Mondstadt hostile and frightened. Amber befriended her despite her warnings, helped her search, and took her to Ludi Harpastum to show her people living happily. When she learned Collei was behind the Black Fire Incident, she chose to help anyway and kept guard while Cyno sealed Collei's power. Collei calls Amber the person she admires most, "like a cozy fire", and traces her archery practice back to a Ludi Harpastum night with her; her first clumsy sewing was a repair of Amber's old clothes. They correspond by letter; Amber was overjoyed to hear that Collei's Eleazar was cured.

Collei's stories recall Amber grabbing her hand at Ludi Harpastum and pulling her through the crowd. Collei is still ashamed of how she spoke to Amber back then.

5.content:
Prologue (1.0). As the Traveler and Paimon left the Whispering Woods, Amber leapt into their path, gave a handbook greeting and demanded they explain themselves, calling Paimon a "mascot". Hearing the Traveler sought a lost sibling, she offered to help with posters. She had them help clear a hilichurl camp, then welcomed them to the city of wind, dandelions and freedom and gave them a wind glider, explaining that "the wind is the heart and soul of Mondstadt". She promised Paimon a Sticky Honey Roast.

Later she took the Traveler into the Temple of the Falcon to destroy one of Stormterror's power sources, admitted that the dragon was once one of the Four Winds, and quoted Lisa: "The winds change, so too should our tactics." She now credits the Traveler with showing her the world beyond Mondstadt.

6.comment: Amber: The Gliding License and Raptor
6.content: In her Story Quest (Lepus Chapter, 1.0) Amber examined the Traveler for a gliding license and accidentally handed them her childhood storybook instead of the manual. The examiner admitted the real manual was too dry for her and that the fable had truly taught her to glide. When Sir Otto mistook the Traveler for an accomplice of the thief Raptor, Amber joined the hunt and made the last exam stage a gliding assault on Raptor's hideout. At a chasm, Raptor mocked "the little girl". She jumped anyway ("The wind says I WILL make it"), caught a current she could not have seen from the ground, and arrested him. She then confessed her own license had been revoked so often she had sat the exam about fifteen times, and signed the Traveler up for the next championship so she would finally have competition.

7.content: Amber's handmade rabbit-eared doll, which taunts enemies into attacking it and then explodes. She says the line has run past "Baron Bunny the 893rd". Klee loves it because it explodes, and Sucrose objects that it looks nothing like a rabbit. Amber taught Noelle to make one, and Noelle carries it for luck (it does not explode). She also gifts friends custom versions, promising they will not blow up. Its design is based on her Outrider uniform.

8.content: Lisa taught Amber magic from "big, thick books" and is the source of the saying "The winds change, so too should our tactics." Amber runs errands for her, which the Traveler likens to a younger sibling serving an older one, and loves her half-finished stories. Lisa remembers Amber as a young girl when she joined and is curious to see her in a few years.

9.content: Amber suspects Kaeya of every oddity, from strange-looking dandelions to the Traveler's unease, and asks whether he gave them trouble. Kaeya, for his part, calls her a clever and righteous knight and warns others not to step out of line in front of her.

10.comment: Amber: Razor and the wolf attacks
10.content: In Razor's Story Quest (1.0) Paimon thought Amber was the "red one, burny girl" Razor knew; she was not, and had never heard of him. Amber investigated wolf attacks around Drunkard Gorge and Springvale, identified Wolvendom wolves from fur and Wolfhook seeds, and met Razor there. She kept him under suspicion while treating his injured wolf with Wolfhook, then invited him to the city for a few days.

11.content: While Varka was away on his expedition, Amber worried that every task fell on Jean. In 6.4, when his letters arrived (one for each knight), Amber helped deliver them to the Adventurers' Guild and The Cat's Tail. She cheered him on the way home ("Fly home to us, Grand Master!") and was among the knights waiting at Windrise when he returned. Varka calls her a ball of energy and, as the first knight most visitors meet, "practically the public face of the organization".

12.content: In 5.6 Amber and Mika held a section of Mondstadt's defences, counting incoming hilichurls, Mitachurls and slimes. Amber found the idea of monsters impersonating loved ones chilling. She had believed Albedo's murder trial was real, and joked that Eula, who had kept the plan secret, was impossible to get secrets out of. Afterwards she invited Klee for tea and Moon Pies.

13.comment: Amber: Eija Gretel and the new reconnaissance
13.content: In 6.2 Amber said Jean was assigning her helpers, including a talented trainee named Gretel learning outrider skills, and that her methods would become teaching material for every company. The paperwork gave her a headache. In the 6.4 Homeward event (limited) she introduced Eija, Signals Officer of the 7th Company, and the armoured falcon Vesper. Eija's goal is to let ordinary knights direct trained falcons as "eyes in the sky", so that scouting no longer depends on rare talents like Amber. The wiki names this NPC Eija Gretel. Lohen reports Amber asked Jean for recon officers (not official Outriders) to share the load.
